title: Task list with filters
describe: a task list with active and done filters
prompt:
Build a task list at /.

Requirements:
- A heading "Tasks".
- A text field labelled "New task" and a button "Add task". Adding appends the task to the list and clears the field.
- Each task has a checkbox labelled "Done: <task title>", for example "Done: Buy paper".
- Filter buttons "All", "Active" and "Done". "Active" hides done tasks and "Done" hides active ones.
- A line "<n> tasks left" ("1 task left" for one) counting the tasks that are not done.
- Keep it all on the client; there is no server.
